review_scope: Blind review of exported film only; no repository or collateral inspected.

media_observation.audio_stream: AAC mono stream is present, but audio was inaccessible for listening in the review environment. No spoken content is inferred from captions.

timeline.observation: Fictional prepared scenario; family-pressure hook; private reflection proposition and entry points.
Private reflection screen; user input and prepared/no-model labels.
Editable tentative reflection; Muse Spark named as a possible theme suggester; no model connected.
Prepared fictional peer example and host modeling listening rather than deciding.
Group-only draft preview, editable text, excluded private context, review checkbox, unchecked consent and disabled continuation.
Local preview disclosure and optional private/share/defer next-step choices.
Repeated assurance that nothing is sent without consent and user may leave it private.

attribution_authenticity: Muse Spark is named, but no Meta AI branding, model call, live output, or provenance is visible. The film clearly labels the example as prepared and no-model-connected, which supports honesty but limits demonstration claims.
recommendation: Revise before using as evidence of a Meta AI-powered product or functioning community experience. It works as a concept film for a non-directive, consent-led reflection flow.
prioritized_fixes: Show an explicitly labeled connected model run, including user correction and confirmed wording; substantiate attribution.
Follow one person to a concrete self-chosen next step and brief aftermath.
Make the real peer network and moderation contribution concrete without implying unevidenced adoption.
Tighten repeated screen holds; enlarge key details and guide attention through the consent and edit actions.
Show correction/recovery for a bad interpretation and clarify data boundaries, retention/deletion, and non-sharing behavior.
